sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Anger, anxiety. Desire for company. Con-
fusion, delusions, illusions.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Violent rush of blood to head with vertigo.
Pain in head better by lying on painful side. Weekly
headache. Benumbing headache mostly around ears.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Region of stomach distended. Enlarged
liver and spleen in children. Pancreatic disease ; re-
lieves burning pain in cancer of pancreas.

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Kidney region sensitive to pressure. Al-
buminuria, passes urine every hour.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:
Constriction and pain in region of heart,
palpitation, oppression and throbbing.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Offensive, bloody leucorrhoea. Cancer of
uterus; burning pain in uterus and vagina.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Removes inflammatory products in
veins of lower extremities. [Apis.; Ars.]
